intent.verbatim: the cost numbers have to come from real token usage in the logs, never made up
intent.decoded: `socom meter` parses real token usage from run logs into the records so the trace cost view is token-real and never fabricated (Phase-2a, GAPS #10).

contract.goal: The meter command exists and feeds the GenAI usage attributes.

check.expect: exit 0: the meter command is compiled in
exit 0: usage flows into the GenAI usage attributes

contract.out-of-scope: Per-provider log-format coverage; this gates the meter exists and is wired.
contract.regression-surface: Fabricated counts or a removed meter must turn this RED (token-real cost).
